## 1. Executive Overview

DestiX AI is an elite private AI systems practice and autonomous conversational telephony studio founded by Ayush Meena. Unlike traditional software agencies that resell generic SaaS wrapper widgets or offshore telecalling call centers, DestiX AI designs, scripts, and deploys high-performance, client-owned voice infrastructure.

DestiX AI operates across two complementary technical disciplines:
1. **Autonomous Conversational Telephony:** Low-latency AI voice agents operating on domestic Indian cellular lines (+91) with sub-450ms voice turn-taking parity, fluent in English, Hindi, and colloquial North Indian Hinglish.
2. **Spatial 3D Digital Architecture:** Bespoke Next.js 15, WebGL, and Three.js high-conversion digital storefronts built with Swiss editorial typography grids and 100/100 Lighthouse performance.

## 3. Technical Telemetry & Latency Anatomy

When procurement teams audit latency claims, DestiX AI deconstructs the physical anatomy of an actual Indian phone call:

| Stage | Process | Typical Industry Lag | DestiX AI Measured Performance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stage 01 | Voice Activity Detection (Silero VAD) | 150ms - 250ms | 80ms |
| Stage 02 | Speech-to-Text Streaming (Deepgram Nova-2) | 250ms - 400ms | 110ms |
| Stage 03 | LLM Time-to-First-Token (Groq LPU / Llama-3.3) | 300ms - 800ms | 120ms |
| Stage 04 | Neural Speech Synthesis (Cartesia Sonic) | 250ms - 450ms | 90ms |
| Stage 05 | Domestic SIP Interconnect Buffer (Tata Tele / Airtel) | 80ms - 150ms | 35ms |
| **Total** | **Full Audio Roundtrip (Turn-Taking)** | **1,030ms - 2,050ms** | **435ms (Human Parity)** |

*Note on Market Claims:* Some providers cite "120ms latency" by measuring only LLM token generation (Stage 3). A real telephone call requires audio synthesis and carrier transmission; DestiX AI measures full ear-to-mouth turnaround (435ms p50).

## 4. Transparent Unit Economics & Pricing

DestiX AI rejects SaaS seat license markups. All deployments operate on an engineering sprint model:

### Wholesale Usage Costs (Direct Pass-Through)
- Wholesale Voice Minutes: ₹4.50 to ₹7.50 per conversation minute ($0.05 to $0.08 USD)
- Domestic Telephony Numbers: Dedicated +91 virtual DIDs (TRAI / DLT compliant)
- Markup on Minutes: 0% (invoiced directly by Tier-1 carrier)

### Turnkey Deployment Tiers
1. **Pilot Sprint (₹1,50,000 / $1,800 one-time):** Single core workflow (e.g. 99acres lead callback), 1 dedicated DID, sub-450ms latency, CRM sync, 14-day turnaround.
2. **Autonomous Suite (₹3,25,000 / $3,800 one-time):** Inbound receptionist + outbound lead qualifier, multi-dialect English/Hindi/Hinglish, automated WhatsApp brochure dispatch, HubSpot/Salesforce integration.
3. **Agency White-Label (₹5,50,000 / $6,500 one-time):** Multi-tenant sub-account provisioning, custom domain portal, wholesale carrier routing, dedicated architecture support.

### The 5x Hurdle Rate Mandate
Before accepting any client engagement, DestiX AI audits the client's current lead volume and CAC. If explicit modeling does not show at least a 5x return on investment over a 12-month horizon, DestiX AI declines the engagement.
